justification: Standard: changes a customer-facing capture path and what is stored as consent. Not Critical: no regulatory data, no DB schema change, additive UI.

pre_impl.existing_data: canibuildit_leads: 9 rows (3 owner tests, 6 real, all Oct 2026); email_sent boolean and consent jsonb NULL on all 9.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: email_sent NULL looked like 'not sent'; the route never wrote it. Resend SDK returns {error} rather than throwing, so a rejected send was silently treated as success.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses WaitlistButton, BuilderReferralCard and /api/canibuildit/lead; no new surface. Adds interest_type granny-flat-referral.
pre_impl.external_source_error: Resend failure now logged and stored as email_sent=false.
pre_impl.frontend_type: onSuccess fires only on res.ok; email_sent boolean, never null for new rows with an id.
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the lead POST fails, flood numbers stay blurred and an error is shown (visible). If the email fails, the lead is still stored and email_sent=false (visible in DB).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Run with origin/main's version of route.ts copied over this branch's
falsifiable_check.observed_red: 6 failed, 2 passed: email_sent never updated; shared_with 'duplex-referral-partner' for granny-flat and plain leads.

functions.name: POST /api/canibuildit/lead
functions.input: lead JSON with email, address, interest_type and consent wording
functions.if_none: no API key -> email_sent=false; insert error -> no update, still 200

functions.name: WaitlistButton variant=email-result
functions.input: an email typed into the flood result unlock form
functions.output: onSuccess on 2xx, lead_submitted event without PII

queries.if_zero: update skipped when insert returned no id

break_it.scenario: Attacker posts a lead claiming a flood verdict for a victim's email
break_it.what_happens: Email from our domain would assert flood risk
break_it.how: flood email carries no finding, only a link that re-runs server-side

break_it.scenario: Someone reads the blurred numbers without giving an email
break_it.what_happens: They can read the six numbers without leaving an email
break_it.how: Accepted: data was already in the DOM before this change and payments are off

break_it.scenario: Granny-flat referral consent recorded as duplex partner

post_merge.secrets: Yes - confirm Vercel RESEND_API_KEY belongs to a Resend account with plotdetect.com.au verified
post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - submit one flood lead with the owner's email after deploy and check canibuildit_leads.email_sent for that row
